connector.name: MCP Image by shinpr
connector.registryDescription: AI image generation and editing with prompt optimization and quality presets
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-image. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the shinpr account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Google Gemini API key for image generation when IMAGE_PROVIDER=gemini (get from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey)

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key for image generation when IMAGE_PROVIDER=openai. Requires OpenAI organization verification to access gpt-image-2 (https://platform.openai.com/settings/organization/general)

env.name: ARK_API_KEY
env.description: BytePlus ModelArk AP region API key required when IMAGE_PROVIDER=seedream

env.name: IMAGE_OUTPUT_DIR
env.description: Absolute path to directory where generated images will be saved (defaults to ./output)

env.name: SKIP_PROMPT_ENHANCEMENT
env.description: Set to 'true' to disable automatic prompt optimization and use direct prompts
